v1.0.1 — Blindaje de limites de confianza: sin --yes nada se ejecuta (auditar_repo.mjs dry-run con plan; verificar_declaraciones.mjs omite el gate y sus detectores estaticos son solo lectura); env del proceso hijo sanitizado por defecto (sin KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/PASSWORD/CREDENTIAL/BEARER/AUTH), --full-env renuncia explicita; seccion 'Limites de confianza' en SKILL.md; test_blindaje.mjs con 5 asertos.

Initial public release of "auditoria-por-ejecucion" skill.

- Provides clear guidelines for verifying project claims via executable commands and exit codes, not documentation.
- Defines a hierarchy of evidence authority, prioritizing code/results over written claims.
- Introduces a three-state verification model: VERIFIED, UNVERIFIED, REFUTED.
- Includes practical checklists and measured cases to avoid common auditing failures.
- Details methods for managing claim ledgers, observation manifest independence, and honest risk reporting.
